correctness.rationale: Central symmetry makes the centroid the origin. The two horizontal faces contribute B(a²+b²)/6+2Bh² and the four vertical faces contribute 2h(a+b)³/6+4h³(a+b)/3; the mixed terms integrate to zero over the symmetric edge or face parameter. Independently, after scaling a+b=1, the deficit D=72J−5A² equals D|_{x=1/4}+24y(1/4−x). The former is a concave quadratic in y with coefficient −20. Its endpoint values on [0,1/4] are 8h(12h²−10h+3)>0 and (4h−1)²(24h+1)/4≥0. Taking the chord and adding the quadratic chord excess 20y(1/4−y) reproduces the displayed certificate. Thus equality forces y=x=1/4 and h=1/4, exactly the cube. Conversely the cube attains 5/72. No numerical tests are needed to cover arbitrarily small positive angles or extreme aspect ratios.
residual_risks: Scope is ordinary area on nondegenerate right prisms. The frozen numerical checks are corroborative only.
